title: Canon of Scripture
definition: The canon of Scripture is the complete collection of writings God has given as His authoritative Word to His people.
summary: The church did not create the authority of Scripture; it recognized the writings God had given. The canon protects the church from adding to or subtracting from the Word God has entrusted to His people.
christFocus: The canon bears unified witness to Christ. The Law, Prophets, Writings, Gospels, and Apostolic teaching together reveal God's redemptive plan fulfilled in Jesus Christ.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: Canon means rule or standard. The biblical canon is the recognized body of writings that belong to the Word of God. These writings guide the church's doctrine, worship, and obedience.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: A clear canon protects the church from false revelation, spiritual confusion, and unstable teaching. Believers need to know where God's authoritative Word is found.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive the whole Bible as God's Word. Do not build doctrine on speculation, hidden writings, private revelations, or teachings that contradict the canonical Scriptures.
